workflows.content:
name: ci
on: [push]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test

name: maintenance
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * 0'
jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: rm -rf /tmp/build-cache

name: team-sync
on: [push]
jobs:
  sync:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./scripts/sync-docs.sh

name: encode
on: [push]
jobs:
  encode:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo build-info | base64

name: publish
on:
  release:
    types: [published]
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: npm publish
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
